values.note:
Prior value before clinical review: None
Actual Phase 3 efficacy: 50; ACACIA-HCM NCT06081894 enrolled 258 aficamten and 259 placebo patients. At 36 weeks the co-primary pVO2 group difference was +0.67 mL/kg/min (95% CI +0.22 to +1.11; P=0.003); KCCQ-CSS difference +3.0 (95% CI +0.5 to +5.5; P=0.02), each significant at prespecified two-primary alpha <=0.025. Small average effects despite positive prespecified endpoints.; Source: https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa2603021; Benchmark: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42624353/; Uncertainty: Effect-size lower CI close to zero clinical benefit; no prespecified regulator-endorsed minimum important pVO2 difference in nHCM. Full SAP, imputation and individual response reliability need detailed audit.
Clinical importance and patient benefit: 50; ACACIA-HCM NCT06081894 prespecified KCCQ-CSS 36-week aficamten +11.4 vs placebo +8.4, adjusted mean difference +3.0 points (95% CI +0.5 to +5.5; P=0.02). NYHA functional class improvement occurred in 41.9% active vs 27.8% placebo, difference +14.1 percentage points (95% CI 6.0 to 22.2).; Source: https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa2603021; Benchmark: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33183512/; Uncertainty: KCCQ-CSS group contrast is relatively small and placebo improved substantially. NYHA class responder evidence supports functioning but needs patient-level distribution, missingness and multiplicity context.
Statistical reliability: 50; Both dual co-primary nHCM outcomes were reported at 36 weeks as positive with 95% CI excluding zero: KCCQ-CSS +3.0 (0.5, 5.5), P=0.021; pVO2 +0.67 (0.22,1.1), P=0.003. NYHA and biomarker secondaries favorable; left atrial volume index P=0.058 and time to first cardiovascular event P=0.678 were not significant.; Source: https://ir.cytokinetics.com/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/Cytokinetics-Announces-Positive-Results-from-ACACIA-HCM-Presented-in-Hot-Line-Session-at-the-European-Society-of-Cardiology-ESC-Congress-2026-and-Published-in-The-New-England-Journal-of-Medicine/default.aspx; Benchmark: https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/multiple-endpoints-clinical-trials; Uncertainty: Prespecified two-primary split alpha does not demonstrate robustness to all missing data, participant exclusions, multiplicity of secondary outcomes or unreported alternative assumptions. Lower bounds of both primary CIs are small.
Replication and durability: 50; ACACIA-HCM NCT06081894 disclosed broadly consistent prespecified subgroups and continued KCCQ gains among remaining participants to 72 weeks; after four-week aficamten washout, KCCQ returned toward placebo. The 36-week peak oxygen and KCCQ improvements occurred in a trial of 517 randomized nHCM patients.; Source: https://ir.cytokinetics.com/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/Cytokinetics-Announces-Positive-Results-from-ACACIA-HCM-Presented-in-Hot-Line-Session-at-the-European-Society-of-Cardiology-ESC-Congress-2026-and-Published-in-The-New-England-Journal-of-Medicine/default.aspx; Benchmark: https://www.nejm.org/doi/10.1056/NEJMoa2401424; Uncertainty: Open-label/extension completer data are selected and no independent second nHCM Phase3 replication or all prespecified interaction CIs are established in this source. Within-trial long-term improvement is not independent replication.
Safety and tolerability: 25; In ACACIA-HCM NCT06081894 reduced LVEF below 50% occurred in 27/258 (10.5%) aficamten vs 2/259 (0.8%) placebo. Serious adverse events occurred in 52/258 (20.2%) active vs 38/259 (14.7%) placebo. LVEF deficits were generally reversible with dose adjustment, but heart failure risk remains relevant.; Source: https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa2603021; Benchmark: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39056349/; Uncertainty: Event denominators and adjudication matter; trial was not powered to prove a difference in rare serious HF outcomes, and reversible LVEF changes still imply monitoring burden. Precise long-term safety outside trial is unknown.
Equal 20% weights. Research only, not FDA probability. Exact-NCT snapshots retained in repository.
